$comment: Where the main story stands, and what's still open in a region: the Journal's Main story section when no chapter is in hand (src/ui/storystatus.js picks which apply; the owner, 2026-10-03). {title}, {giver}, {town}, {level}, {n}, {of}, {cls} are filled from the sim and the quest words.
level: Next: {title}, once your hero reaches level {level}.

fens.title: Act II is done
fens.text: The Abbess is down and the choir-lamp is glass on the floor. Ilse has read the ledger twice: the Cult was mining the dead, and the buyer's mark is the Kell Assay's. The Wickham road north to the Cinder Reach is open.

reach.title: Act III is done
reach.text: Furnace Nine's lamp is broken and the night shift is home, forty-one of them, counted in at Ashgate's gate. The vessel's mould was empty: Morrow Vane is a day ahead on the Solmere road with what was cast in it. The rest of the Old Provinces comes in a later update.

tidemark.title: Act IV is done
tidemark.text: Lucan Varro was beaten on his own steps, not killed. He read the Kindler's letters, left unopened on his own table, and walked north to the Heights after the vessel, which left with the Kindler days ago. The Pilgrims' Stair, through Solmere, is open. The rest of the Old Provinces comes in a later update.

leads.brannoc: Wickham Keep: someone is still chained in the Old Cellars' last hall, where Captain Garrow kept him. Go down and see.
leads.standard: The Sunken Chapel: the Standard of the Third Legion still stands over the binding in its crypt, and holds the barrows road with it.
leads.warren: Old Skarn's goblins are in Wickham Keep's bailey, selling stolen hens to the Redhand: Hedda, by the well, wants their chief told.
leads.chronicle: The Vale's Chronicle: {n} of {of} pages found. The Chronicle tab says where the rest were lost, and together they say where something was buried.
leads.milestone: The Ninth Milestone is open: the legion's strongroom, out where the old road runs on past the Deepdelve mine.
leads.trial: A trial for your {cls}: {giver} in {town} teaches it.
leads.board: The Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule, has new jobs every day.
leads.toadking: Toadking's Mound, out in the reeds: the Toadking keeps the third-floor hall, and somebody tied up beside his berth-book.
leads.wren: Toadking's Mound: the Toadking is down, and the woman tied in his Boat Hall is still there. Go back down and cut her loose.
leads.choir: The Drowned Abbey: the Drowned Choir still sings in the second-floor hall. Somebody should stop them.
leads.owed: Dace Pike has something of Wren's he wants settled. Ask him at the Drowned Eel, in Saltmere.
leads.fenschronicle: The Fens' Chronicle: {n} of {of} pages found, at the Mound, the Locks and their vats, and the Abbey. Sister Ilse reads them in Thornwick.
leads.undercroft: The Reedholm Undercroft is open: the binding clergy's copy-room, under the priory past the Abbey. The key's on the nail by the door.
leads.tower: The Mere Tower: the ferry at Saltmere's quay crosses to it. Climb it as far as you can.
leads.fensboard: The Lantern Guild's board, at the Drowned Eel, has new Fens jobs every day.
leads.foreman: The Cold Seam, off the Wickham road south of Ashgate: the goblins' foreman keeps the tally cave, and somebody is chained at his anvil.
leads.tamsin: The Cold Seam: the Foreman is down, and Tamsin Coalbrook is still at the goblins' anvil in the tally cave. Go back down and bring her up.
leads.reachboard: The Lantern Guild's board hangs by the bellows in the Slag & Bellows, Ashgate's tavern.
leads.showingoff: Haldor wants something looked into about the Assay's work. Ask him in Ashgate, at the forge or the Slag & Bellows.
leads.reachchronicle: The Reach's Chronicle: {n} of {of} pages found, in the Cold Seam, the Assay Yards, the Forgehall and the Cinderworks. Sister Ilse reads them in Thornwick.
leads.ninthvault: The Ninth Vault is open: the quota office's strongroom, up the old track on the dead volcano's flank past Kell's Rest.
leads.harbourmaster: The Drowned Mole, at the end of Gullwick's ferry jetty: the old harbour's moles stand bare at low water, and the Harbourmaster still keeps the berths on the outer one.
leads.maren: The Drowned Mole: the Harbourmaster is down, and a Grey Sister is still holding the harbour office on the moles. Go back down and bring her up.
leads.hesk: The Gull Isles: the landing jetty is on the harbour bay's west shore, past the salt marsh. Admiral Hesk keeps the flagship's great cabin.
leads.lampfort: The Lamp Fort, on its headland out along the cliffs east of Tollhaven: the Gull Fleet is in its yard, and Old Gannet is at the gate.
leads.brinecross: Brine Cross, on the road west of where the Highmarch road comes in: the League is holding the bridge's east barricade, and the drowned fleet's crews are marching on it.
leads.champion: Highmarch, at the head of the Highmarch road north of the coast road: go in through the breach in its walls. The Seventh's Champion keeps the great bastion.
leads.lucan: Highmarch: the Champion is down. The dungeon's second floor is the Seventh's Palace, and Lucan Varro waits in its throne room.

nextFound: Next: {title}. {giver} has it for you: tap her card, in the party or on the bench, then Talk.
